title: Context-intelligence Unit D: session/task memory graph with closed-schema digests, derived parents, quarantine (D-013)
objective: Closed-schema session/task memory digests whose parents are DERIVED (digest->task->directive/milestone; requirement links->requirement entities; files->code-graph nodes; subsystem only via the versioned Unit-C resolver); two-pass extraction+deterministic resolution; grounding required (task scope/diff/evidence/owner-approved relation); unresolved/ambiguous/stale/ungrounded links quarantined; promotion atomic, idempotent, replay-safe, concurrency-safe with tested crash points; invalid advisory tags discarded separately, never quarantining a valid digest.
business_reason: D-013 Unit D; depends on Unit C resolver (sequencing requirement).
inputs: tools/subsystem_resolver.py + tools/subsystem_entities.py (accepted Unit C: versioned resolver, two-pass entity validation, index digests — consumed read-only)
tools/repo_index_cache.py IndexCache/SingleWriterLock/cache_dir_for (accepted A2 atomic generation store, reused as the external memory-graph store — consumed read-only)
tools/repo_fingerprint.py + tools/repo_index_incremental.py (accepted A1/A2 identity: repo_sha, source-manifest fingerprint — consumed read-only)
D-013 requirements R009/R011/R044/R045/R046/R047/R048/R050/R051 (closed schema, derived parents, grounding, quarantine, atomic promotion, storage classes)
outputs: tools/memory_digest.py — CLOSED digest schema (schema_version 1.0.0): exact allowed field set (unknown fields refuse), required R044 fields (stable content-derived digest_id, task_id, requirement_ids[], files[] with digests, agent from the repo-derived allowlist, outcome enum, repo_sha, source-manifest fingerprint, branch, task/directive index digests, resolver/ontology versions, evidence refs, unresolved_links, advisory tags separated), fail-closed validation with machine-readable codes

tools/memory_grounding.py — deterministic R047 grounding: a structural link requires authoritative task scope/diff/evidence/owner-approved relation, existence alone never suffices; per-link machine-readable grounding verdicts

tools/memory_graph.py — two-pass promotion pipeline (validate -> propose via Unit C -> resolve -> ground -> quarantine or promote) into an external per-checkout generation store reusing the accepted A2 IndexCache (atomic, idempotent by digest_id, replay-safe, single-writer locked); digest-level and link-level quarantine records with reasons; invalid advisory tags discarded separately; bounded CLI (promote/show/check)
tools/test_memory_graph.py — executable AS-1..AS-6 acceptance tests + crash-point injection, concurrency, idempotency, replay, staleness and quarantine edge cases
docs/MEMORY_GRAPH.md — the memory-graph contract: schema, grounding rules, quarantine semantics, promotion guarantees, storage location, Unit E consumption notes

acceptance_scenarios.given: digest documents with an unknown extra field, a missing required field, an agent outside the repo-derived allowlist, an outcome outside the enum, and a digest_id that does not match the content-derived id
acceptance_scenarios.then: every one refuses with a machine-readable code (closed schema, fail closed) and a fully valid digest validates; the allowlist derives deterministically from .claude/agents/*.md stems + orchestrator (D-013-R044/R013)

every parent is DERIVED via pass-2 code: digest->task->milestone via the packet + master plan, requirement->directive via the registry, file->subsystem only via the versioned Unit-C resolver (resolver/map versions + task/directive index digests stamped into the promoted node); no model chooses any structural link (D-013-R045/R046/R044)

acceptance_scenarios.given: a digest claiming a file link that EXISTS in the tree but is grounded in neither the task packet scope nor the provided diff/evidence nor an owner-approved relation, plus an unresolvable requirement link
acceptance_scenarios.then: those structural links are QUARANTINED with machine-readable reasons (ungrounded_file_link / unknown_requirement_id) and never silently enter the graph; existence alone is never sufficient (D-013-R047)

acceptance_scenarios.given: the same digest promoted twice, and a crash injected between the temp write and atomic promotion on a fresh store
acceptance_scenarios.then: double promotion is idempotent (identical generation, no duplicate nodes); the crash leaves the prior valid generation intact (never a half-written graph) and the replay completes cleanly to the identical final state (D-013-R048)

acceptance_scenarios.given: an otherwise valid digest carrying one invalid advisory tag
acceptance_scenarios.then: the digest PROMOTES with the invalid tag discarded into a separate machine-readable record; the digest itself is never quarantined for an advisory tag alone; valid advisory tags stay leaves, never structural parents (D-013-R048/R045)

acceptance_scenarios.given: a second writer holding the store lock, and a store location resolving inside the repository
acceptance_scenarios.then: the locked attempt refuses safely with a machine-readable error (no corruption, single-writer serialization) and the in-repo location refuses (cache_inside_repo) — the memory graph lives only in the external per-checkout runtime directory and is never committed (D-013-R048/R050/R011)

risks: Grounding too permissive would let ungrounded links into the graph (R047 violation); mitigated by default-deny grounding (existence never suffices) + AS-3
Scope creep into Unit E: this unit builds digests + promotion + store only; NO repository-intelligence views or status projections (Unit E, M0-T068)
path_free_justification: Paths bound at claim (2026-08-18) after M0-T066 acceptance, per the D-013 sequencing reservation (source-002). New memory-digest schema + grounding + promotion modules reusing the accepted A2 store and Unit C resolver read-only; no existing module is rewritten.
